pr_body:
Fixes #2267 Compile to js doesn't modify script type=application/ts to
type=application/javascript

<!---
Thanks for filing a pull request 😄 ! Before you submit, please read the following:

Search open/closed issues before submitting since someone might have pushed the same thing before!
-->

# ↪️ Pull Request

When a HTMLAsset script tag has a type different from text/javascript
and application/javascript, the HTMLAsset class does not rename the
type property of the tag to a valid application/javascript, and so this
fix forces that when a script tag whose sub asset has a detected a script of type js,
and has been transformed properly it will rewrite the type property of
the script tag to application/javascript.

Same issue happens with CSS, when a style tag with type property != to text/css is found
and it's sub asset is properly transformed then the final tag will include valid css and it's type
property will be transformed to a proper text/css type. 

## 💻 Examples

<!-- Examples help us understand the requested feature better -->

## 🚨 Test instructions

In order to test this fix the following steps must be done:
1. Create a simple html page with a style tag and/or a script tag.

1a. Style tag must have valid LESS or SCSS code and must include property type with the corresponding value (e.g. text/less, text/scss)

1b. Script tag must have valid typescript or elm or any other valid parcel supported code and must include property type with the corresponding value (e.g. application/typescript, application/elm...)

2. Run parcel

3. Check build folder configured and the script and/or the style tag type property should now be application/javascript and/or text/css
## ✔️ PR Todo

- [ ] Added/updated unit tests for this change
- [x] Filled out test instructions (In case there aren't any unit tests)
- [x] Included links to related issues/PRs

issue_context.title: Compile to js doesn't modify script type=application/ts to type=application/javascript
issue_context.body:
<!---
Thanks for filing an issue 😄 ! Before you submit, please read the following:

Search open/closed issues before submitting since someone might have asked the same thing before!
-->

# 🐛 bug report

Out of the box, the compilation to js of some <script type="application/ts">...</script> works but in the resulting html the type attribute is kept intact (application/ts) and the browser (firefox in my case) doesn't execute the produced javascript

## 🎛 Configuration (.babelrc, package.json, cli command)

```
yarn global add parcel-bundler
yarn init -y
```

```
{
  "name": "compile-to-js",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "main": "index.js",
  "license": "MIT",
  "devDependencies": {
    "typescript": "^3.1.6"
  }
}
```

## 🤔 Expected Behavior

The produced html should contain type="application/javascript" 

## 😯 Current Behavior

The produced html contains type="application/ts"

## 💻 Code Sample

index.html:

```html
<!doctype html>
<html>
    <body>
        <script type="application/ts">
            type TT = "bouh" | "bar"
            function log(t: TT){
                console.log(t)
            }
            log("bouh")
        </script>
    </body>
</html>
```

```parcel index.html```

Result: 

```html
<!doctype html>
<html>
    <body>
        <script type="application/ts">function log(t) {
  console.log(t);
}

log("bouh");</script>
    </body>
</html>
```

## 🌍 Your Environment

<!--- Include as many relevant details about the environment you experienced the bug in -->

| Software         | Version(s) |
| ---------------- | ---------- |
| Parcel           | 1.10.3 |
| Node             | v11.1.0 |
| npm/Yarn         |  6.4.1/1.9.4 |
| Operating System | OSX |
